title: Jais and Jais-chat: Arabic-Centric Foundation and Instruction-Tuned Open Generative Large Language Models
measurement_description: The paper evaluated the model's ability to avoid sensitive religious topics as part of its safety alignment. It also measured stereotype biases against protected attributes, including religion, using the CrowS-Pairs dataset.
findings: As a safety measure, the model was trained to avoid engaging in discussions on sensitive topics, including religion and politics. The Arabic system prompt for Jais-chat explicitly includes the instruction to 'Refuse to write verses from the Quran'.
